DIAGNOSIS READY: Metastatic Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Neck (from an occult primary, likely head and neck origin given history of smoking/alcohol risk factors and clinical presentation).

Given your history of colon cancer and diabetes, and the presence of a hard, painless neck mass with hoarseness, this is highly suspicious for a malignant neck mass. The "Normal Readings" on your initial labs do not rule out malignancy, and the hoarseness suggests vocal cord involvement or nerve compression. I will proceed with imaging to locate the primary tumor.
